title: Resize confirmation with one-step Undo
summary: Confirm flattening before resizing editable objects, with cancellation that preserves your image and one Undo to restore everything.

Added: Resize Image displays Flatten Objects when editable objects are present. Flatten All commits the resize; Cancel, Escape and close preserve the existing document.
Flattening and resizing are one undoable command. Original pixels remain available for Revert, and saved projects retain the flattened composite.
Fixed: Very small image sizes no longer fail editable-text limits after flattening confirmation. Revert status correctly describes restoration of the previous image state.
Verified: Native Cancel/Escape, confirmation, Undo/Redo, save and64000 exact clipboard pixels; all256000 stored pre-resize composite pixels and original source retained.
85 regular Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy cover history, persistence, input ownership and invalid-input rollback.

limitations: ClipCraft keeps the original image behind the warning; reference candidate-preview behavior and accepted reference filter output remain unverified.
Print units/DPI, selected-object flattening, interactive/off-canvas crop and complete reference UI parity remain unfinished.
Editable projects retain original source pixels; share flattened PNG output when originals should not be recoverable.
